errors.what: First sweep draft passed refine=0 to the take fits; the board's take survey refines tau, so every candidate misfit ~500 ppm and scored alike
errors.fix: matched the board call (tau refined, TAKE_SURVEY_AFTER) before any scored run

errors.what: per/angles first stretched periods by angle*per instead of angle, so the fit's rpm output was N times high (drop ratio and rms unaffected: scale-invariant)
errors.fix: caught by the new unit test, fixed; the main run's drop/rms numbers do not depend on it

errors.what: Chained the robustness runs on main.jsonl reaching 512 lines; the grid is 256 balls, so the chain waited ~10 minutes doing nothing

integrity_issues.issue: Clause (d) of the prediction (the per-ball bound) was added after a 3-ball look at the curves, before the main run and before commit 225c6308a; stated in the script, eval note and post. It did not change the verdict: (d) failed.

doc_friction.issue: 60+ sweep scripts and no index: finding how the board's take survey calls the fit (refine on, TAKE_SURVEY_AFTER) meant reading controller.LaunchCheck._take_survey; a one-line 'how to refit like the board' helper or note would have saved a misfit run

deviations.why: llms.txt and marketing page not touched: the change is a host-side test and a closed firmware item with no user-facing behaviour change

notes: Pre-registered (225c6308a) paired simulation, 256 balls: (a) failed 46 vs 38 of 128, (b) held 7 vs 16 of 32, (c) held, (d) failed 207/256 bound coverage. Item closed by rule; board unchanged (per=1 default byte-identical, unit-tested). Unjudged robustness: 2 deg spacing same picture; 0.5 us sensor jitter: 4 magnets saw 24 vs 9 short-take balls and bounded them at median 3.5 ms vs none (98% coverage) - recorded in NEXT.md as the lead for a reopened test. Local: run_venture_tests.py open-tennis-robots ok (448 tests, 0 failed, 59 skipped for build123d); check_posts ok; promptctl validate ok. PR CI green on checks completed at last look.
